## Inference and display code and outputs {#rd04-source-review}

This section is the authoritative source review for RD04 prediction, inference,
and display implementation. It reads the original scripts and saved CSVs on
every render. The [F01 analytical record](task-f01.qmd#f01-pipeline-review)
owns the upstream component derivation and fitted-model candidates; the
[fuel pipeline map](pipeline-fuel.qmd) shows their dependencies.

### Complete RD04 scripts

Stage 07 audits inference; stage 08 generates the current integrated-mean
figure and estimates. Their shared inference functions are included here.
Stage 06 and its archived implementation are retained as historical evidence.

### Complete RD04 CSV outputs {#rd04-csv-review}

These tables preserve all audit and estimate cells, including saved numeric
precision. The companion table above formats the same canonical estimate CSV;
RT03 consumes that CSV without taking ownership of its inference decisions.

```{r}
#| label: rd04-csv-source-review
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false

source("scripts/render-csv-review.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
tasks <- jsonlite::fromJSON("tasks.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
review_task <- Filter(function(task) task$id == "RD04", tasks)[[1]]
groups <- c(
  `inference-audit` = "Inference audit and historical comparisons",
  `tables` = "Figure and companion-table estimates"
)
for (directory in names(groups)) {
  cat("\n#### ", groups[[directory]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  prefix <- paste0("publication/outputs/fuel/", directory, "/")
  paths <- sort(unlist(review_task$outputs))
  paths <- paths[startsWith(paths, prefix) & endsWith(paths, ".csv")]
  for (path in paths) render_csv_review(path)
}
```
